ep7-phil-q1.speaker: Clancy
ep7-phil-q1.text: Do you have any advice for people who are dealing with death in their own lives?

ep7-phil-a1.speaker: Death
ep7-phil-a1.text: Yeah. So the best thing you could possibly do for yourself in your entire life, I think, is be super present for those moments.

ep7-phil-q2.speaker: Clancy
ep7-phil-q2.text: What is that system? This seems truly like the conspiracy nobody talks about.

ep7-phil-a2.speaker: Death
ep7-phil-a2.text: Yeah, it's one of my favorite conspiracies, is, like, the death industrial complex.

ep7-phil-q3.speaker: Clancy
ep7-phil-q3.text: Can you tell me what these tart-baking mirrors are?

ep7-phil-a3.speaker: Death
ep7-phil-a3.text: This is a trial of judgment. All these mirrors reflect parts of yourself that you're ashamed of, stuff you try to hide from yourself. You have to forgive them.

ep7-resolution.speaker: Death
ep7-resolution.text: Besides, you're not gonna die yet. That'll be on a rolly chair.
